The IPIP-50 Big Five questionnaire

Source: R/fct_item_bank.R
ipip50.Rd

The questionnaire built into the app: the 50 items of the IPIP Big-Five Factor Markers (Goldberg, 1992; public domain), 10 per trait, with the coefficients of a rating scale model fitted with mirt to each trait separately, on the responses of 19,718 people to the Big Five test of the Open-Source Psychometrics Project. The 18 reverse-keyed items were reversed (6 - answer) before the fit.

ipip50()

Value

A list: bank, the item bank (see read_item_bank), with the traits in the order Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism, and likert, the five answer options (see read_likert).

See also

Other item bank: read_item_bank(), read_likert(), validate_item_bank_against_mirt()

Examples

q <- ipip50()
table(q$bank$scale)
#> 
#>     Agreeableness Conscientiousness      Extraversion       Neuroticism 
#>                10                10                10                10 
#>          Openness 
#>                10 
q$likert
#>   value                           label
#> 1     1                 Very inaccurate
#> 2     2           Moderately inaccurate
#> 3     3 Neither accurate nor inaccurate
#> 4     4             Moderately accurate
#> 5     5                   Very accurate
